verdict.rationale: Codegen's own docs show agents running in vendor-run sandboxed environments. A developer starts them with only an org_id and token via the SDK or API, and connects repos through a GitHub App with 'no complex setup required', so no self-hosted backend is implied. However, the docs never explicitly describe a fully managed cloud with an infrastructure-free guarantee, and nothing independent confirms it. missing for 10: explicit documentation that agents execute on Codegen-hosted cloud infrastructure with no customer-operated backend, details on hosting/scaling and parallel capacity, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use a managed cloud offering to run agents without operating my own backend infrastructure
